name: content-grid-01
title: Content Grid 01 - Dated Entries As Cards, Rows Or A Compact Index
description: A grid of dated entries composed from whatever the caller passes: a name, a summary, an optional reading, category, length, figure and link, drawn as cards, as full-width rows, or as a compact index. Every string, every figure and every annotation is a prop, and the slug claims no publication, because the shape is needed by a changelog, a research index, a release history and a case study set and by none of them a blog.
